text:
tess_sales: quick one - MedAtlas wants POC but insists on strict EU-only processing for PHI. they asked: any chance of traffic spilling to non-EU if EU capacity is saturated?
arjun_presales: do they accept read-cache outside EU or is it absolute no-cross-border?
tess_sales: absolute no-cross-border for any patient data. read-cache might be allowed if it's anonymized, but legal will confirm.
sam_infra: hosted can route by region but has a fallback path when regional capacity is exhausted (usually to nearest region). that would break strict requirement.
arjun_presales: so Dedicated or Private is the safe route?
sam_infra: correct. Dedicated with region-pinned pools or Private VPC keeps data in chosen region and disables cross-region failover.
ops_bot: checklist: Dedicated = reserved capacity + peering + certs; typical lead 8-12 business days after PO.
nora_legal: MedAtlas will need our EU subprocessor list and a signed attestation. can someone pull the latest per-region subproc CSV?
arjun_presales: attaching link in questionnaire in a follow-up (we have cloud-hosting-eu, logs-eu, metrics-eu). note: some global monitoring agents exist but they don't store customer PHI outside EU when on Dedicated/Private.
tess_sales: BYO-KMS question: can their AWS eu-central-1 KMS be used so keys never leave EU?
sam_infra: BYO-KMS supported for Private and for Dedicated when using regional keystore integration; hosted public does not guarantee key residency today.
arjun_presales: pricing ballpark for POC with small Dedicated pool and occasional spikes?
sam_infra: estimate: ~11k/month baseline + one-time setup ~4k. will refine after workload profile.
nora_legal: we'll need an SLA amendment for no-cross-border clause; legal review ~5-7 business days once we send a draft.
tess_sales: action items: 1) share subproc CSV + BYO-KMS caveat, 2) send Draft Dedicated quote, 3) schedule technical sync with MedAtlas. can we have quote + packet tomorrow morning?
arjun_presales: yes, I'll prepare quote and a one-pager stating guarantees and limitations.
sam_infra: I'll reserve a tentative provisioning window week-after-next.
ops_bot: reminder: include BYO-KMS key rotation and revocation steps in the handoff doc.
tess_sales: thanks all, i'll email MedAtlas and schedule sync.
